veranderings.blok: Shaka se dood en sy nalatenskap
veranderings.rede: An apposition in running prose reads more naturally between commas than in brackets.

vlae.blok: Nandi se dood en die rou
vlae.rede: 'sou lei' can mean either that it did lead to a shortage or that it would/was expected to; the intended certainty cannot be chosen without guessing the content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
